plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-12 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) English - Rhetoric and Writing Emphasis program page and its linked official degree map workbook, 'English & English Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', 'Rhetoric & Writing (Campus)' tab, last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (16/14/16/14/15/15/15/15) and the plan to the catalog's printed BA degree total of 120. BA-only program: the catalog prints a single line, Total Credits, BA Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly; no BS option is printed. The catalog's Bachelor of Arts Degree Requirement is 16 foreign-language credits (four semesters of a foreign language, or testing out and purchasing the credits; one semester may also fulfill the General Education Humanities requirement); the map's four LANG rows (1010/1020/2010/2020 at 4 credits each) satisfy it exactly. The catalog's General Education block prints only Core Course Requirements (12+ credits) and Breadth Area Requirements (16+ credits) with 'See General Education for course options'; the map's GE rows are recorded as printed. The catalog's Free Electives section prints no fixed figure (the total is determined by the General Education courses taken, degree type, additional credits earned and prerequisite courses needed). Catalog-versus-map difference, disclosed, not reconciled: all three English maps print 'LANG 1020 Intermediate Language I' in Fall Year 2, reusing the code printed in Spring Year 1 for LANG 1020 - Beginning Language II; the slot is recorded as LANG 2010 - Intermediate Language I, the third-semester number in SUU's four-semester language sequence as printed on other official SUU degree maps. Catalog titles are recorded where the map abbreviates or substitutes '&' for 'and'. GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes. Cross-check: the catalog's English - Rhetoric and Writing Curriculum totals 45 credits (Core Required Courses 6 + Rhetoric and Writing Core 18 + Rhetoric and Writing Electives 21), and the map exercises exactly 45 major credits: every named Core and Rhetoric and Writing Core course appears (ENGL 1410, 2400, 2700, 2860, 3860, 4160, 4360 and ENGL 4800 - Literature Senior Capstone, which the catalog lists inside the Rhetoric and Writing Core), and the seven generic major elective slots (one Major Elective in Spring Year 2 and six Major Upper-Division Elective slots) total exactly the Electives block's 21 credits. The catalog's Electives pool is AILE 3300, COMM 3110, ENGL 2870, ENGL 3960, ENGL 4890 (1-9 credits), the 3000-level literature surveys (ENGL 3110, 3210, 3215, 3220, 3230, 3235, 3240, 3270; no more than 9 credits of surveys may count) and the 4000-level literature courses (ENGL 4110, 4210, 4310, 4320, 4510); the slots are recorded generically as the map prints them with the pool disclosed here.
